```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here()) # knit from project directory

library(tidyverse)
theme_set(ggthemes::theme_few())
```

# Load sample data

```{r}
df_flower <- read_csv("alldata/input/NPN/flower/Acer/2025.csv") |>
  filter(phenophase_description == "Open flowers")

df_leaf <- read_csv("alldata/input/NPN/leaf/Acer/2025.csv")
```

# Data cleaning

#Load functions

```{r}
source(here::here("code", "clean_data.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_resolving_conflict.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_leading_no.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_trailing_yes.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_window.R"))
```

#Use functions to clean flower and leaf data frames

```{r}
df_flower_clean <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year",
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14,
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14,
    max_doy = 213
  )

df_leaf_clean <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year",
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14,
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14,
    max_doy = 213
  )
```

# Calculate onset day

Load function

```{r}
source(here::here("code", "calc_first_yes.R"))
```

Calculate flower onset date for both raw and cleaned data frames

```{r}
df_flower_onset <- df_flower |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_clean <- df_flower_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

bind_rows(
  df_flower_onset |> mutate(group = "original"),
  df_flower_onset_clean |> mutate(group = "clean")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = day_of_first_yes)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1) +
  labs(x = "Data Type", y = "Day of First Observed Yes", title = "Flower Onset") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)))
```

Calculate leaf onset for both raw and clean data frames

```{r}
df_leaf_onset <- df_leaf |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_leaf_onset_clean <- df_leaf_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

bind_rows(
  df_leaf_onset |> mutate(group = "original"),
  df_leaf_onset_clean |> mutate(group = "clean")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = day_of_first_yes)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1) +
  labs(x = "Data Type", y = "Day of First Observed Yes", title = "Leaf Onset") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)))
```

# Compare all data cleaning functions separately

```{r}
df_flower_observation <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year")

df_flower_no <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14)

df_flower_yes <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14)

df_flower_max <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    max_doy = 213)

df_leaf_observation <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year")

df_leaf_no <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14)

df_leaf_yes <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14)

df_leaf_max <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    max_doy = 213)
```

Calculate the flower onset data for each of the applied cleaning
functions

```{r}
df_flower_onset <- df_flower |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_clean <- df_flower_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_observation <- df_flower_observation |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_no <- df_flower_no |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_yes <- df_flower_yes |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_max <- df_flower_max |>
  calc_first_yes()

flower_master_onset <- bind_rows(
  df_flower_onset |> mutate(group = "original"),
  df_flower_onset_clean |> mutate(group = "all methods"),
  df_flower_onset_observation |> mutate(group = "conflict resolution"),
  df_flower_onset_no |> mutate(group = "leading no"),
  df_flower_onset_yes |> mutate(group = "trailing yes"),
  df_flower_onset_max |> mutate(group = "window")
) |>
   ggplot(aes(x = group, y = day_of_first_yes, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = okabe_ito <- c("#E69F00","#F0E442","#D55E00",
                                            "#56B4E9", "#009E73","#0072B2")) +
  geom_jitter(alpha =.1) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("original", "leading no", "trailing yes", "conflict resolution", "window", "all methods")) +
  labs(x = "Data cleaning function", y = "Flower Onset Date") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)), axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)))
flower_master_onset
```

Calculate the leaf onset data for each of the applied cleaning functions

```{r}

df_leaf_onset_max <- df_leaf_max |>

leaf_master_onset <- bind_rows(

  df_leaf_onset_clean |> mutate(group = "all methods"),
  df_leaf_onset_observation |> mutate(group = "conflict resolution"),
  df_leaf_onset_no |> mutate(group = "leading no"),
  df_leaf_onset_yes |> mutate(group = "trailing yes"),

) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = day_of_first_yes, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = okabe_ito <- c("#E69F00","#F0E442","#D55E00",
                                            "#56B4E9", "#009E73","#0072B2")) +
  geom_jitter(alpha =.1) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("original", "leading no", "trailing yes", "conflict resolution", "window", "all methods")) +
  labs(x = "Data cleaning function", y = "Leaf Onset Date") +

leaf_master_onset
```

```{r}
#join plots and add annotations
library(patchwork)

#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4

flower_master_onset <- flower_master_onset + labs(x = NULL)
flower_master_onset / leaf_master_onset + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

```

Visualize flower onset

Load US map

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4

us_map <- map_data("state")

flower_onset <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = us_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "lightgrey", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = df_flower_onset, 
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, fill = day_of_first_yes),
             shape = 21, size = 3, alpha = 0.5, stroke =0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#D1EFAF", "#BBD997", "#A8CB7C", "#98B76C", "#849F5B", "#6C804C", "#586E3B","#405724", "#2F4814", "#1F320B")) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, 
              xlim = c(-125, -65), 
              ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Flower Onset", fill = "Day of Year")
flower_onset

flower_onset_clean <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = us_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "lightgrey", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = df_flower_onset_clean, 
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, fill = day_of_first_yes),
             shape = 21, size = 3, alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#D1EFAF", "#BBD997", "#A8CB7C", "#98B76C", "#849F5B", "#6C804C", "#586E3B","#405724", "#2F4814", "#1F320B")) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, 
              xlim = c(-125, -65), 
              ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Flower Onset Clean", fill = "Day of Year")
flower_onset_clean

#join plots and add annotations
flower_onset + flower_onset_clean + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

```

# Calculate Flower-Leaf Sequence (FLS)

Combine data frames

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4

#calculate FLS by subtracting flower onset date from leaf onset date. Negative values would indicate leaves emerged first
merged_raw <- inner_join(df_flower_onset, df_leaf_onset, by = "individual_id") |> 
  mutate(FLS = day_of_first_yes.y - day_of_first_yes.x) 

merged_clean <- inner_join(df_flower_onset_clean, df_leaf_onset_clean, by = "individual_id") |>
  mutate(FLS = day_of_first_yes.y - day_of_first_yes.x)

#load US map
us_map <- map_data("state")

#Visualize
sign_sqrt_trans <- function() {
  scales::trans_new(
  name = "sign_sqrt",
  transform = function(x) sign(x) * sqrt(abs(x)),
  inverse = function(x) sign(x) * (x^2)
    )
  }
FLS_raw <- ggplot() +
   geom_polygon(data = us_map,
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "lightgrey", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = merged_raw, aes(x = longitude.x, y = latitude.x, fill = FLS),
             shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#FFB81C",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "#003594",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       transform = sign_sqrt_trans(),
                       limits = c(-max(merged_raw$FLS), max(merged_raw$FLS))) +
  coord_fixed(1.3,
              xlim = c(-125, -65),
              ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Flower Leaf Sequence", color = "Number of Days")
FLS_raw

sign_sqrt_trans <- function() {
  scales::trans_new(
  name = "sign_sqrt",
  transform = function(x) sign(x) * sqrt(abs(x)),
  inverse = function(x) sign(x) * (x^2)
    )
  }
FLS_clean <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = us_map,
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "lightgrey", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = merged_clean, aes(x = longitude.x, y = latitude.x, fill = FLS),
             shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#FFB81C",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "#003594",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       transform = sign_sqrt_trans(),
                       limits = c(-max(merged_clean$FLS), max(merged_clean$FLS))) +
  coord_fixed(1.3,
              xlim = c(-125, -65),
              ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Flower Leaf Sequence Clean", fill = "Number of Days")
FLS_clean

#join figures and add annotations

FLS_raw + FLS_clean + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

```

# Linear Regession with latitude

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

regression_raw <- inner_join(df_flower_onset, df_leaf_onset, by = "individual_id") |>
  mutate(FLS = merged_raw$day_of_first_yes.y - merged_raw$day_of_first_yes.x) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude.x, y = FLS)) +
 geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
 geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Flower Leaf Sequence", title = "Raw Data Frame") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  ggpubr::stat_regline_equation(label.x = 40, label.y = -250) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(label.x = 40, label.y = -280)
regression_raw

regression_clean <- inner_join(df_flower_onset_clean, df_leaf_onset_clean, by = "individual_id") |>
  mutate(FLS = merged_clean$day_of_first_yes.y - merged_clean$day_of_first_yes.x) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude.x, y = FLS)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  xlim(30, 50) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Flower Leaf Sequence", title = "Clean Data Frame") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  ggpubr::stat_regline_equation(label.x = 40, label.y = -60) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(label.x = 40, label.y = -70)
regression_clean
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 4

#join figures and add annotations

regression_raw + regression_clean + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

```

```{r}

(flower_onset + flower_onset_clean) / (leaf_onset + leaf_onset_clean) / (FLS_raw + FLS_clean) / (regression_raw + regression_clean) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')
```
